name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US elimination status reported lost (14 Nov)
summary: PAHO has concluded the US has lost measles elimination status, US media reported 14 Nov; 10 US deaths in 2026
state: PAHO concluded during the week of 9 Nov that measles transmission has been re-established in the US, ending elimination status held since 2000, according to researchers with knowledge of its deliberations; a public announcement was planned for 17 Nov (KFF Health News, 14 Nov). The CDC counts over 5,400 US cases in 2026, more than double 2025, and states report 10 measles-associated deaths this year; PAHO had not commented publicly (Contagion Live, 14 Nov). Loss of elimination status meets Watch.
for_you: Two doses of MMR vaccine prevent about 97% of infections. Check your and your children's vaccination records against NHS or CDC guidance, and follow official travel health advice before visiting areas with outbreaks.
rubric_hit: Watch: loss of elimination status (US, reported 14 Nov) and large outbreaks in high-income countries

sources.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
Reports say US loses measles elimination status after 26 years

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
